purpose: Produce a source-bound corrected view of the delayed-funding capital taxonomy without rewriting the original research artifact. Separate subscription cash received from XRP purchase cost and remove a duplicate contextual row from the canonical category view.

source_authority.hash_scope_note: The source_artifact_git_blob_sha is a Git blob SHA-1 binding to the exact derived research artifact preimage. It is not a SHA-256 hash of raw SEC filing bytes.

source_artifacts.role: Immutable research-artifact preimage containing the duplicated delayed-subscriber XRP category and a rounded $214.1M value in the purchase-cost row.

primary_source_evidence.arithmetic_check: $214,049,995 cash received - $214,000,000 purchase cost = $49,995 restricted cash at 2025-12-31.

field_corrections.reason: This category is the historical cash-funded XRP purchase cost, not the rounded subscription-cash receipt.

field_corrections.original_value: Aggregate Pubco private-placement cash reported by issuer and used to buy 84,365,876 XRP; may already include the $10.5M delayed-subscriber cash component.
field_corrections.corrected_value: Aggregate Pubco private-placement cash used to purchase 84,365,876.3625 XRP. The SEC filing records $214,000,000 of purchase cost. Exact advance-funding cash received was $214,049,995; $49,995 remained restricted at 2025-12-31. The $10.5M delayed-subscriber cash may already be included in the broader private-placement aggregate; do not add it separately without subscriber-level reconciliation.
field_corrections.reason: The previous status conflated cash received with cash deployed.

field_additions.reason: Exact cash receipt disclosed in the SEC filing.
Rounded subscription cash in the issuer summary.
Exact quantity from the SEC cost-basis table; retain amount_xrp as the rounded display value.
The subscriber-level composition is not reconciled against the broader private-placement cash aggregate.
Prevents double-counting the $10.5M delayed-subscriber cash component.

array_deduplications.canonical_note: Canonical-view correction: the repeated row in the immutable source artifact is a duplicate contextual representation of the same 200,000 XRP consideration, not a separate contribution or capital category.

corrected_interpretation: Cash received exact: $214,049,995. Summary-rounded subscription cash: $214,050,000. XRP purchase cost: $214,000,000. Restricted cash at 2025-12-31: $49,995. Exact XRP purchase quantity: 84,365,876.3625. Issuer-reported average price: $2.53657058. The $10.5M delayed-subscriber cash and 200,000 XRP in-kind consideration may overlap the broader Pubco private-placement aggregates; neither is additive without subscriber-level reconciliation.

application_contract.correction_mode: Verify the exact Git blob SHA-1 of the original artifact, deep-copy it, apply the listed field corrections/additions, merge the duplicate-row status into the first matching category, and remove later duplicate category rows only in the derived in-memory view.
application_contract.fail_closed: If the source blob SHA differs, do not apply the correction; archive and verify the exact preimage before any migration.
application_contract.reason: This is a historical capital-accounting correction, not a current XRP flow or point-in-time predictive feature.
